scenario: Hearing (WPV2): mid-call the caller is thinking about the address and says only hesitation sounds, no words. This is case (b) of skip_turn: Anna waits silently instead of re-asking or checking the line.

chat_history.message: Здравствуйте. Это Анна, ИИ-ассистент Smart Comfort Group. Чем могу помочь?
Здравствуйте, я по поводу замены стояков.

success_condition: The agent calls skip_turn (system tool; no parameter checks) and says nothing: no re-ask, no «Алло, вы меня слышите?», no repeated question. The harness checks that there is no speech (expect.no_speech).
